column1: # perf-attribution TSV -- 2026-09-01 seat01 -- row rtx-startup-touch-rewrites, ## NEXT item 2
# (x86_argroles: the 861 surviving R_X86_64_RELATIVE relocations left after the 2026-08-28 150->1 copy
#  collapse. A pointer-to-string-literal is not a link-time constant in PIC, so each of the 123x7
#  `const char *` fields was written at load time, dirtying its pages and pinning the table in
#  .data.rel.ro. Fields are now 16-bit offsets into one x86_argrole_blob; table and blob are .rodata.)
# instrument: /usr/bin/time -v, 5 runs/arm, mean reported; same box, same tree, `make pristine` BOTH arms.
#   RT_OPT=-O0 (NO -O2 BUILDS). SCRIP bcb0ec1e. Witness = OUTPUT=1 (the do-nothing RT-load floor).
# METRIC IS FAULTS + MAXRSS, NEVER WALL CLOCK -- per hq_P's standing direction for this lane: relocation
#   PROCESSING was already measured cheap (~0.4% of the floor); the cost being graded is page-DIRTYING.
# ARMS: baseline = SCRIP bcb0ec1e unmodified, pristine. blob = same tree + this rung, pristine.
#   Runtime rows REPRODUCED across two independent pristine builds of the blob arm (m3 minflt 742.4 / 742.2;
#   reloc count identical 5176 both) -- the reported blob numbers are from the final pristine tree.
# SEPARATION: no run-range overlap on any runtime row (baseline m3 minflt 747-749 vs blob 741-744;
#   baseline m4 755-757 vs blob 751-752), so the deltas are above run-to-run noise at n=5.
# ⚠ STRUCTURAL rows (reloc, section bytes) are EXACT readings of the linked .so, not sampled means.
